content: Pita Amrlzle Kzdq Ncblo Kxbxplo
Kzdq zbq Pita x Jon nzvzdzng mz Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe mz nzkrka'ngr mz nabznepi kc tqtq.

X kzdq kc ncblo nanycde bxplo pnz mzli kc mzte tzmc-ngrde. Mzbq kang kqlu nzglqbz x nzamnctrpz yz mz drkq ngr Mangr-nzangiongr, mrkc tqycngr ‘Naonrx Kxluli,’ murde narlxbz trau mz lr Jiu kcng tzvztrng brma.
Kx mc-kzle Pita x Jon nzvztr-krdr, sc tqrlxpe-kzpz trau badr.
Zbz Pita x Jon nzobqtxtrpzng mz mzte x rpibz Pita kx, “Obqm bagr!”
Zbz ncblo kc obqtxbz badr, nzpnzkr drtwrde le, sc nakabzlr kzdq trau.
A' rpibz Pita kx, “Trpnzngr scnge trau, a' nakabo da kx ngiscnge. Mz zmatq ngr Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, kc Naszret, tulzm x vzne!”
Zbz otibzle mqde kxrtc, sc tqatulzpemle. Mzli kcpwz nanycdeng x rtudx ngr nanycdeng nzxplrtx-pnzng.
Blctxlz pnz x sc tqabzopele nzvzne-krde. Zbz sc tzvztrpeng badr mz Naonrx Kxluli kc mz Mangr-nzangiongr, tqvzne, tqblc, x tqglqpxle Gct.
Nzmc leplz amrlx nzvzne-krde x nzxlrbzlr nzglqlz-krde Gct.
Kx nzkrlzlr kx nide ncblo kc tqwxbune, tqrlx zvz da mz Naonrx Kxluli, nzkctitxpx-atwrnr-pnz-ngrdr.
Pita Ryapwxbz Mz Leplz
Mzli kc ncblo kc tqblitrbe-ngrbzle mz Pita x Jon mz nzabrtz-krde, leplz amrlx sc tzkctitxpxpelr. X sc tzvopebzng mz nzyrkr-krbzlr badr mz makoa nyz Solomon.
Kx mctxbz Pita leplz kcng, sc tqrpipebzle badr kx, “?Lr Israel, nike tqkctipx-ngrnamu da lc x nike tqpwxbzti-ngrnamu nigr? Murde travznekru ncblo lc mz zmatq ngrgr x mz nztubq-krgr. Trtingr!

Murde Gct rgu kc tqangio Ebraam, Aesak, Jekop, x melrmqgung, sc tqamrluepele kxnzawz nede Jiszs mz nzatulz-krmlele mz nzbzngr x avzdzpele nide Heven. Aprcbzmu nide mz nzrnibqngr x pxtxpx-ngrnamu nide mz mz Paelzt, kxmule-esz' rpile narlrpx-ngrde nzvz-krde.
Pxtxpx-ngrnamu krkc tqtr tqtubq-esz'ngr, a' rlxtiamu kx Barabas kc tqrnibq narlrpx-ngrm x navz.
Kxmule-esz' nibqtxnamu Mevalu, a' atulz-mop Gct mz nzbzngr x mckr nide mz nibr nztulz-krmle.
X ncblo lc tqbxplo nzaxplrngr nide x nzamrlzngr nrkrdrtqde tuo mz nzrlxngitingr Jiszs. X krlzamu ncblo lc amrlx ngrmu mzli kc, x mcpeamu mz mzpu da kc tqwaile mzli kcma.
“Mzli ka, kx mzlengeng, krlzx kx nimu badr kxnzrmailz ngrmung nibqamu Jiszs, murde trkrlzwamuu kx nide Kxnzmcpx ne Gct.
A' mz nzale-krmu da lc, Gct atutrle natqdeng kcng tzplzpx profet nedeng amlrx mzli kc bqnc, mz nzrpi-krdr kx drtqde naetq.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, natekqtramu nqmq nr drtwrmu x nayzlutiamu Gct, murde naipqpxbzle alwx ngrmung.
X Gct namnc-zvzbz bamu x na-amrna-mopwzle nabzmu. X na-atwzlr-mou-ngrmle Jiszs bamu. Murde Gct mcpxle nide mz nzngini-krde Mevalu rmu.
Jiszs esz'-krde namnc Heven nakrlzbzle mzli kc Gct na-atubqti-mou-ngrde da amrlx, mz nzvz-nqblq-krde natq profet nedeng kcng bqnc.
Murde Mosis, profet ngrgu kc kai, ycmnetr-ngrde Jiszs mz nzrpi-krde kx, ‘Yawe Gct rgu sa na-atulzle kzdq profet kxetu mz mzlirgu kx na-apule ninge. Lalztqbzmu mz nike pibzle bamu.
Doa kx trlalztqpwzu bade nakapxm Gct mz leplz nedeng x naodati-atwrnr-ngrde.’”
Rpi-mopwz Pita kx, “X abzo mz Samwel x profet kcng amrlx tzvzmqng mz nibrde, nzpipxlr da kcng tqangidatipe Jiszs mzbq kang x mzbq lcng navztrpqng.
Da kcng tqesalz-ngrbz Gct mz profet nedeng x mz Nzesz'tikr Drtwrdr badr melrmqgung, twzku mzli ka. Gct rpibzle mz Ebraam kx, ‘Mz nqvi lrm sa na-amrlzx leplz amrlx mz nrlc.’
Dekc Gct tqatwzlr-kai-ngrmle Jiszs, kxnzawz nede bagu, nigu lr Jiu. Murde na-amrlzle nigu mz nzbatr-krbzle mz doa kxesz', nzesablqti-krde nqmq krde kxtrka x nzlxlvrti-krde Gct.”
